results.title: Cabins for You | BBB Complaints | Better Business Bureau
results.content: Having to wear shoes inside due to dirty floors, not being able to fully enjoy the pool area, and dealing with broken games and amenities is extremely frustrating, and we regret knowing this was your and your guests' experience. 3 days after returning from the cabin, $1500 was charged to my bank card stating that there was damage to the pool table with pictures attached of a piece of broken plastic (cosmetic) on the outside of the pool table. Upon arrival my son was stabbed in the foot with a trim nail, less than an hour on the property and my son needs to go to urgent care which they stated to us our insurance would have to pay for not cabinsforyou (how great as we are on vacation out of state), the cold air return vent on the stairs had unclipped and slammed down hitting the wall on a few occasions leaving a gouge in the wood on the wall which could have resulted in a head injury, the A/C went out in the bottom half of the house for almost 2 days, the door lock to the hot tub wasn’t working for almost 3 days, 2 different door handles broke off during our stay, and the top rack in the dishwasher was broken. While we understand our resolution may not have fully made up for the disappointment, we are glad we could process a refund to acknowledge the impact these issues had on your stay. We processed a refund to recognize the impact these issues had on your experience, and we genuinely regret that your stay fell so short of expectations. Corey, we completely understand how upsetting it must have been to encounter so many issues upon arrival, and we sincerely apologize for your disappointing cabin experience. I am responding mainly to this comment "While we were not aware of all of the issues you were experiencing until later in your stay" ---- I am not sure how much sooner CABINS FOR YOU wanted to receive issues when I told the representative about it on the 14th. We completely understand how frustrating this stay must have been for you and your family, REMOVED, and we, again, sincerely apologize for your disappointing experience.
